content.title: About
content.content: Fluid replacement, 5% glucose in water is an isotonic intravenous solution containing 5% (50 g/L) glucose in sterile water. It is used to replenish fluid and energy losses and to maintain electrolyte balance in various clinical situations.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The solution has an osmotic pressure close to plasma, allowing safe large‑volume administration.
A 5% glucose concentration provides a rapid energy source for tissues, especially the brain and heart.
It is frequently used as a base solution for adding electrolytes, vitamins, or medications.
Sterility is achieved by filtration and autoclaving, eliminating microbial contamination risk.

items.title: Fluid volume restoration
items.content: Enables quick replenishment of extracellular fluid lost due to dehydration, hemorrhage, or burns.

items.title: Energy support
items.content: Glucose supplies an immediate source of fuel for cells, supporting metabolism.

items.title: Reduced risk of hypoglycemia
items.content: When administered in appropriate amounts, helps maintain normal blood sugar levels in patients receiving non‑glucose medications.

items.title: Convenient combination
items.content: The solution can serve as a carrier for added electrolytes, antibiotics, or vitamins, simplifying therapy.

items.title: Hyperglycemia
items.content: Excessive infusion may raise blood glucose, especially in diabetic patients.

items.title: Fluid overload
items.content: Large volumes can cause edema, particularly in patients with heart or kidney failure.

items.title: Allergic reactions
items.content: Rarely, reactions to packaging components (e.g., latex caps) may occur.

items.title: Contamination from improper storage
items.content: Store at 2–8 °C in the original sealed container; deviation can allow microbial growth.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Administer intravenously according to physician orders. Dosage is calculated based on fluid loss, body weight, and clinical condition. The solution may be diluted or used as a base for adding electrolytes if needed.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in the original packaging at 2–8 °C, protected from light. Do not use after the expiration date. Discard if the solution becomes cloudy, contains precipitate, or develops an off‑odor.
